product_one_liner.value: Eden provides a cloud-native diagnostic operating system and medical-imaging AI that unify imaging workflows, interpretation and reporting for radiologists, imaging centers and health systems.

pricing_page.notes: A publicly accessible registration page lists study-volume plans and monthly prices; it is on the older site, not linked from the current homepage.

employee_band.notes: Reported company-size band; published headcount estimates conflict, including a 100-person team size on Y Combinator and 541 on the company profile.

eng_blog.notes: The readable indexes contain product guides, healthcare education and marketing content, not two engineer-authored accounts of building the product.

public_docs.notes: Public product guides contain multiple articles with operating instructions, including keyboard shortcuts, study preloading and mammography hanging protocols.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live listing: Member of Technical Staff, AI Research – Radiology Foundation Model.

model_provider.notes: Eden publicly names its own transformer-based medical-imaging foundation model; the technology page labels Cortex an investigational device. No external model provider is asserted.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly displayed compliance claims, not independent verification of certification; HIPAA is a compliance framework rather than a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 2025 round falls within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Y Combinator board lists only the AI research role. The older company careers section lists Sales Executive, but not an SDR, BDR or Account Executive title; it is not counted under the specified title rules.

launched_6mo.notes: Eden announced Cortex on 2026-10-06: medical-image analysis and complete diagnostic report generation for radiologist review.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Felipe Kitamura announced joining as Chief Medical Officer on 2026-03-02; Eden published a welcome announcement on 2026-03-10.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A 2024-07-24 Senior Business Development Representative recruitment post explicitly requests HubSpot; this establishes a historical usage signal, not verified usage in November 2026.
